# axm skills prune

Remove unmanaged skill artifacts from the workspace

## When to use

Remove unmanaged skill artifacts from the workspace

## Usage

```bash
axm skills prune [flags] <patterns...>
```

## Arguments

| Name       | Type   | Required | Description                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `patterns` | string | Yes      | Glob patterns to filter which unmanaged skills to prune |

## Flags

| Name          | Type    | Required | Description                                                                     |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`     | choice  | No       | Prune in project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y` | boolean | No       | Remove artifacts without confirmation                                           |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Preview unmanaged skill artifacts that can be removed**

```bash
axm skills prune
```

**Remove all unmanaged skill artifacts**

```bash
axm skills prune --yes
```

**Preview unmanaged skills matching a glob pattern**

```bash
axm skills prune effect-*
```

**List prunable artifacts as JSON without removing**

```bash
axm skills prune --json
```

**Remove artifacts and output what was removed as JSON**

```bash
axm skills prune --yes --json
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
